_doc: The 32 iPhone cards of the Designer Library (assets/library-ads/), as iPhones LA picked them on 2026-11-03, with the words each feed still carries. Every claim below is one the library's own cards already make (same-day payment, any condition, any carrier, we meet you locally, no fees, free quote, firm quote by text, cash or transfer, the five towns, iPhone 15 to 18 Pro Max); nothing new is promised. A seller is asked for the IMEI or serial, never a picture (the owner, 2026-11-03: the shop's chatbot quotes from what is typed, 'pics is less ideal since we don't analyze photos as much'). 'line' replaces the card's small middle line (20 of the 32 carried 'iPhone 18 Pro Max • 18 Pro • 17 • 16 • 15', a model list that says nothing about how the service works) and is set at body size; 'cta' sits over the number.
